_README: ASSUMED PARTICLE SIZE DISTRIBUTIONS - one per solids character.
This is the SITE's suspended sediment, not anything about the hydrocyclone.
It is used ONLY when no site-specific measurement exists. The moment a real
PSD or a filtration trial is recorded in data/field-observations.json for a
EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A GUESS. They are starting estimates chosen so
the screening can run at all, and they are the weakest link in the whole
chain - weaker than the geology, weaker than the cut sizes. Every verdict
downstream inherits that. Edit them freely as field evidence accumulates.
d10/d50/d90 are micrometres: the size below which 10 / 50 / 90 % of the
SOLIDS MASS lies. A log-normal curve is fitted through them.
THE TRAP THESE NUMBERS MUST AVOID: the suspended load of a river is
normally much finer than its bed material. A sandy riverbed does not mean
sandy suspended solids. Sand sits on the bed; what stays in suspension is
the fine tail. If these figures start looking optimistic in the field, this

sand.note: Sand-dominated suspended load. Coarse enough that a hydrocyclone has real material to work on. Most likely to be over-optimistic: see the trap above.

mixed_mineral.note: Mixed mineral load spanning silt into fine sand. The middle case.

silt.note: Silt-dominated. Mostly at or below the cut size of a small hydrocyclone.

clay.note: Clay-dominated, cohesive. Almost entirely below any small hydrocyclone's cut size. Expect the screening to say so.
